caci_worksheets.title: CACI – Primary Hemochromatosis Worksheet

criteria.ame_must_review: Treating physician finds the condition is: - Stable and asymptomatic; - NOT due to a secondary hemochromatosis; and - No treatment changes recommended

Treating physician documents NO evidence of: - Arthropathy; - Cardiomyopathy or other cardiac disease; - Cirrhosis or other hepatic disease; - CNS disease (including cognitive deficits); - Endocrine disease including diabetes; hypopituitarism, hypogonadism, or hypothyroidism; - Kidney disease; - Polycythemia; - Myeloproliferative disorders; and/or - Other condition requiring multiple transfusions
Labs (within past 90 days): - Hemoglobin 11 mg/dL or higher - Ferritin level less than or equal to 150
Current treatment: Note: Maintain hydration following phlebotomy and no fly for 24 hours. If more than one unit of blood is removed (greater than 500mL), no fly time is 72 hours.
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] None or dietary changes OR [ ] Phlebotomy no more frequently than monthly

notes_html:
*Note:

Co-morbid conditions for FAA purposes include:

  • Arthropathy;
  • Cardiomyopathy or other cardiac disease;
  • Cirrhosis or other documented hepatic disease;
  • CNS disease (including cognitive deficits);
  • Endocrine disease including diabetes, hypopituitarism, hypogonadism, or hypothyroidism;
  • Kidney disease;
  • Polycythemia;
  • Myeloproliferative disorders; and/or
  • Other condition requiring multiple transfusions
